scope: Preliminary event-level comparison; not goal success attribution

play_user_rate.method: Wilson score intervals; Newcombe difference interval
play_user_rate.interpretation: The 95% interval includes zero; this analysis does not show a clear difference between the rates.

purchase_user_rate.method: Wilson score intervals; Newcombe difference interval
purchase_user_rate.interpretation: The 95% interval includes zero; this analysis does not show a clear difference between the rates.

notes: Rates use unique triggered users as denominators.
The outcomes are simulated and depend on the simulator seed.
The difference is agent rate minus holdout rate.
Confidence intervals quantify sampling uncertainty under the binary-outcome model; they do not correct bias or data-quality issues.
These event-level metrics do not establish goal-specific success.
Do not claim causal uplift without validating randomization, assignment integrity, outcome attribution, and holdout isolation.
